why: Stage 5 rank 20: a throw inside a synchronous array-method callback is the enclosing unit's throw, the statement holding the call one opaque block (as a loop statement with a throw already is); a throwing unit or a throwing arrow handed to an outside call is the opaque function value it already is. check is untouched. doubled throws on zero too (unproved; lane B WITNESS on an array holding 0). checked calls the unit inside an arrow instead of handing it (proved: the same call per element through the named-callback reading). viaOutside hands a different function value (unproved; WITNESS: the outside receives another value). viaArrow is untouched.
